route: Student residence permit, studies under two years (Migri)

evidence.excerpt: In order to get a residence permit, you must take out private insurance that will cover your medical and drug expenses.

evidence.locator: What kind of insurance do I need?, amount by duration
evidence.excerpt: If your studies take less than two years, your insurance must cover medical expenses up to EUR 120,000.

evidence.locator: What kind of insurance do I need?
evidence.excerpt: If you stay in Finland for less than year, your insurance must be valid throughout your entire stay in Finland.
